tagline: Product and engineering hires for fintech and payments teams
intro: We find product managers, engineers and designers for fintech and payments companies. Every search starts with a written brief, agreed with you before we approach a single candidate.
audience: Scale-ups and established payments firms in London, across the UK and in Europe, hiring from senior individual contributors up to heads of department.
pricing_note: A percentage of first-year base salary, agreed in writing before we start and invoiced only when your hire starts. Retained searches are split into three stages.

services.title: Contingent search
services.description: For single roles where you are also hiring directly. We send a short list of people we have properly spoken to, and you only pay if one of them joins.

services.title: Retained search
services.description: For senior and leadership roles. A dedicated search with a mapped market, a written update every week and a shortlist you can compare side by side.

services.title: Team builds
services.description: When you need several engineers or a whole product squad at once. One brief, one point of contact, and interviews planned around your team's week.

services.title: Hiring brief workshop
services.description: A half-day session that turns a loose headcount into a role brief: scope, level, salary band and interview loop. Yours to keep, whoever you hire through.

process.title: Write the brief
process.description: An hour with the hiring manager to write the role up properly: the work, the team, the band and the must-haves. You sign it off before anyone is approached.

process.title: Search and screen
process.description: We approach people who match the brief, speak to each one ourselves and send a short list with a written note on every candidate and why they fit.

process.title: Interview and close
process.description: We run the scheduling, gather feedback from both sides after each round and handle the offer conversation until your new hire has signed.

proof.text: They wrote the brief better than we could have, and the shortlist matched it.
Three of our first five platform engineers came through one search.
proof.source: VP Engineering, a Series B lender (sample)

proof.text: Every candidate had already heard the hard parts of the job.
